endpoint: GET /2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/pullrequests and GET /2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repo_slug}/commit/{commit} (Bitbucket Cloud REST API 2.0)
capture: Constructed from the documented paginated pull request and commit response shapes, with next links, 12-character source commit hashes and the draft flag; not captured from a live workspace, since no delivery lane holds a provider token.
redactions: None needed: the workspace, repository, pull requests and hashes are invented.
